# Ehoro Village
> AI programs and learning practice in the New York metro area, led by Ade Ijidakinro (Program Manager, AI & Learning) since 2024.

## Services (https://www.ehorovillage.com/services.html)
- AI workflow automation (Python, n8n, Zapier, with AI steps), from $100
- Dashboards and data cleanup in Google Sheets or Excel, from $50
- Custom AI assistants (ChatGPT or Claude) with instructions, knowledge files and a test transcript, from $150
- Team AI workshops on request
AI tools assist; a person scopes, tests and checks every deliverable. Clients never share passwords.

## Work (https://www.ehorovillage.com/work.html)
- Directed a five-model AI production program (Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini, Codex) that shipped a 113-adventure narrative game in about three weeks.
- Quality audits that caught tests reporting success while 6 of 9 game modes did nothing.
- A documented AI-assisted method across 24+ build sessions.
- Lo-Fi Spirits, a live web app with 45 documented releases (https://www.ehorovillage.com/village.html).
